english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7, 13(1) and 18(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definitions of 'packer', 'package', 'importer', 'outer container' and 'nominal quantity'
(ii) Regulation 10(4) provides that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
(iii) It shall be a defence to prove that the defendant took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of an offence - regulation 19(4)
